name: httpparse
algorithm: Parse a deterministic splitmix64-generated batch of valid and malformed HTTP/1.1 requests (RFC 9112 request line, headers, framing/smuggling checks, fixed Content-Length and chunked body decoding) from contiguous memory buffers, aggregating counts and a wrapping FNV-1a 64 digest over parsed fields (README.md).
quick_checksum: ok=9460 err=540 hdrs=65200 body=662180 chunked=2200 keepalive=4300 fnv=3ec1585cef55ac2d
notes: The strict RFC 9112 HTTP/1.1 request parser is the task itself (README.md), so every cell is kind std with zero external dependencies.
Mk uses std.simd.IndexByte (an allowed std dispatching routine, appRowViolations), matching C memchr, Go bytes.IndexByte, Zig std.mem.indexOfScalar and C# ReadOnlySpan<byte>.IndexOf.
Overflow class wraps: the FNV-1a 64 digest wraps by definition; all counts stay well within i64 bounds.
The publish arguments are provisional until verify -publish-size confirms the 1 s floor on a quiet machine.
